name: titan
description: A Distributed Redis Protocol Compatible NoSQL Database

documents.title: Why Titan?
documents.text: Completely compatible with Redis protocol Full distributed transaction with strong consistency Multi-tenancy support No painful scale out High availability Thanks TiKV for supporting the core features. The project is developed and open sourced by the Beijing Infrastructure Team at Meitu and has been donated to DistributedIO org.

documents.title: Quick start
documents.text: Can't wait to experiment with Titan? Just follow 2 steps: 1. curl -s -O https://raw.githubusercontent.com/distributedio/titan/master/docker-compose.yml 2. docker-compose up Then connect to Titan using redis-cli Enjoy!

documents.title: SetUp TiKV cluster
documents.text: Titan works with 2 TiDB components: TiKV PD To setup TiKV and PD, please follow the official instructions

documents.title: Run Titan
documents.text: Build the binary Edit the configration file Run Titan For more details about Deploy Titan, click here.
